name: South Korea
summary: East Asian peninsula nation with heavy industrial manufacturing centers. Balances high per capita industrial energy consumption with ambitious offshore wind and clean battery industrial initiatives.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 4.68x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); yellow dust events and dense domestic industrial coal/transport emissions impact Gyeonggi.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; KMA recorded highest nationwide average temperature since 1973.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Korean meteorological stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.6% share of global fossil emissions; heavy steel, semiconductor, and petrochemical export industries.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: High per capita emission profile driven by coal baseload and heavy industrial power intensity.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Post-war national reforestation success story; mountainous terrain hosts ~62,000 km² of pine and deciduous canopy.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Solar generation provided 5.4% and bioenergy 3.1%; grid remains dominated by nuclear and coal.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Dense arithmetic population density of 531 people/km²; urban population fraction is 81.4%.
